notes: v2.1.0 — App renamed to Dialer (الهاتف). Copy a phone number anywhere and the app prompts Call / Add to contact / Cancel on return. Share any text containing a number into the app for the same prompt. Active calls now shrink into a floating Picture-in-Picture window when you leave the screen, tap to return. Ongoing-call notification is fixed: Mute / Speaker / Hang up buttons actually fire, and tap goes back to the call screen. Recents now collapses every call from a contact — across all their numbers — into a single entry. Dialpad suggestions tolerate spaces, dashes, parentheses, and country-code variants; tap a suggestion to place the call instead of just filling the pad. Long-press the delete key to clear the input. Duplicate scan shows where each contact is stored and skips suggestions whose contacts live in different accounts. Contact picker now mirrors the main list with collapsible A-Z sections. Recents row 'Save as new contact' renamed to 'Add to contact' and routes through the existing Create new / Add to existing chooser.
